notes.summary: The page continues a discussion in which p double prime is literally an inclusion but morally still a fibration with very well-behaved fibres. The author says the last diagram should admit a direct purely algebraic construction in the schematic setting after construction of the étale tubular neighbourhood has been developed. He then presents the relevant constructibility data, in the current special case, as a span of ordinary homotopy types, or pro-types in the étale setting, with locally constant coefficients at X_0 and X_1 and a compatibility map after pullback to the common source.
manuscript_explicit_uncertainty: ``qui est susceptible d’une construction directe, purement algébrique'' is an assertion of prospect, not a construction supplied on this page.
``lorsque l’on a développé la construction du voisinage tubulaire étale'' is the stated condition.
``Ce serait un exercice amusant (que je n’ai pas encore fait) de'' explicitly reports an unperformed exercise; ai is visually doubtful.

workflow_feedback: The once-only visual sequence and one-crop-per-place rule are workable; grouping the contiguous L13 correction in one crop avoids misidentifying its guide as a deletion.
The brief could explicitly state how to classify Unicode quotation-style normalization in H when the manuscript has high paired ticks; this report lists those sign differences as other.

The distinction between an interlinear parenthesis’s physical baseline and its exact logical attachment needs a standard convention where no caret is visible. Here its position is documented without claiming an unsupported writing chronology.
Mandatory 2500–3500 pixel enlargement of a 6–8 pixel isolated mark adds no source information; the report states that limitation.

structural_checks.methods: Structural text checks only: brace stack, environment stack, math-delimiter parity, required markers, report completeness and path existence. No TeX engine, format builder, compilation or rendering invoked.
